description: This PHP class `DataRegistrationService` provides functionality to send registration data to a specified remote URL, using Guzzle HTTP client. It includes methods for configuring the HTTP client and handling registration data transmission, with error logging.

classes.name: DataRegistrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for sending registration data to a remote server, managing HTTP communication and error handling.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Guzzle HTTP client with a base URI configured from the application's registration URL.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data via POST request to the server if in production mode; logs errors if exceptions occur.
